transcript.user: Can I just keep my money in deposits and bonds?
transcript.content: Yes, that is your choice. Term deposits and government bonds are the low-risk part (Safety), and they pay steadier returns that don't follow stock or crypto prices, so your whole picture swings less when markets fall. One thing to keep in mind: a term deposit stays locked until it matures, so it is not your emergency money. Your emergency fund is the separate vault you already have, and it covers unexpected costs.

transcript.user: When a term deposit matures, should I move some into stocks?
transcript.content: That choice is yours. When a term deposit matures, the money comes back to you, and you can keep it as Safety, put it in another low-risk form, or invest some of it in Traditional or Crypto. Stocks and crypto can fall in value, sometimes sharply, so only move money you are comfortable seeing go down.
